title: Projects
description: Everything your studio is working on, with health and progress from the real task data.
portalOnHint: This project is open to the client in their portal.
openTasks: {count, plural, one {# open task} other {# open tasks}}
emptyBody: Create your first project to plan work, share updates and collect client feedback.
emptyBodyMember: You don’t have access to any project yet. Ask an admin to add you to one.
noActiveBody: Every project here has been archived.
noArchivedBody: Archived projects stay readable and can be restored at any time.
filteredEmptyBody: Try a different health, client or search term.
archivedNotice: This project is archived, so it’s read-only.
archivedNoticeManager: This project is archived and read-only. Restore it in Settings to make changes.

new.title: New project
new.description: A template sets up the workflow, milestones and a few starter tasks.
new.name: Project name
new.keyHint: Used in task IDs, e.g. HPC-12.
new.clientHint: Link a client to share updates and collect approvals later.
new.noClients: No clients yet. You can link one later.

blank.name: Blank project
blank.description: A standard workflow with no tasks. Start from scratch.

client-website.name: Client website
client-website.description: Discovery, design, build and launch for a client site, with review gates.

brand-identity.name: Brand identity
brand-identity.description: Research, concepts, refinement and guidelines for a brand.

retainer.name: Ongoing retainer
retainer.description: Continuous support work fed by client requests.

overview.noDescriptionManager: No description yet. Add one in Settings so everyone knows the shape of the work.
overview.progressHint: Completed tasks ÷ tasks that count (cancelled work is excluded).
overview.milestoneHint: Milestones give the client something concrete to follow.
overview.dueNote: Health turns off track automatically when the due date passes with work still open.

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.hint: Dated checkpoints. Tasks can be attached to one.
milestones.emptyBody: Add the checkpoints this project is measured against.
milestones.name: Name
milestones.shareWithClient: Show this milestone in the client portal
milestones.shareHint: Clients see the name, date and status — not the tasks behind it.
milestones.deleteBody: Tasks attached to this milestone keep their place and lose the milestone.

updates.title: Status updates
updates.hint: The latest update sets the project health.
updates.computedHint: Health is estimated from overdue and blocked work until someone posts an update.
updates.emptyBody: Health is estimated as {health} from the task data. Post an update to say it in your own words.
updates.emptyBodyReader: Nobody has posted a status update yet.
updates.dialogBody: A one-line summary, the health you want to report, and optional detail.
updates.detailsPlaceholder: What moved, what’s next, anything you need from the client…
updates.shareWithClient: Share this update with the client
updates.shareHint: It appears in the portal and notifies the client contacts.
updates.sharePortalOff: Open this project in the client portal first (Settings).

members.title: Project members
members.hint: Project roles decide who can edit. Owners and admins manage every project.
members.addBody: Only internal members can join a project.
members.added: {count, plural, one {# member added} other {# members added}}
members.removeBody: They keep their organization account and lose access to this project’s work.
members.emptyBody: Add the people doing the work so they get notifications and can edit.

portal.title: Client portal
portal.hint: Clients only ever see items you share, one by one.
portal.onDescription: The client’s contacts can open this project in their portal.
portal.offDescription: Nothing in this project is reachable from the portal.
portal.enabled: Project opened in the client portal
portal.disabled: Project closed in the client portal
portal.needsClient: Link a client to this project before opening it in the portal.

settings.detailsHint: Changes are saved against the version you loaded, so nothing is overwritten silently.
settings.goalsHint: Up to ten short statements of what this project is for.
settings.addGoalPlaceholder: Launch a site the client approves on schedule
settings.conflictBody: This project changed while you were editing. Reload to see the current details, then reapply your change.
settings.statusesHint: The workflow comes from the project template and is fixed in this release.
settings.noAccessBody: You can see this project but not change its settings.

danger.title: Archive and delete
danger.hint: Archiving is reversible. Deleting hides the project for everyone.
danger.archiveBody: It becomes read-only and leaves the active list.
danger.archiveConfirmBody: Nothing is lost: the project turns read-only and can be restored here.
danger.restoreBody: It becomes editable again and returns to the active list.
danger.deleteBody: The project and its work disappear from the workspace. An owner can restore it from organization settings for 30 days.
danger.deleteConfirmBody: Tasks, documents, files and approvals go with it. Recoverable from organization settings for 30 days.

activity.title: Project activity
activity.hint: Everything that happened in this project, newest first.
activity.empty: No activity in this project yet

documents.title: Documents
documents.emptyBody: Create a brief, a spec or meeting notes.

files.title: Files
files.hint: Attachments and deliverables in this project.

requests.title: Requests
requests.hint: Client and internal requests attached to this project.
requests.emptyBody: Requests converted into this project’s work will show up here.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.hint: Review rounds on this project’s files, documents and milestones.
approvals.emptyBody: Send a file version or milestone for review to start one.
